title: Exhibition brings together ancient arts and contemporary works in dialogue with nature
description: Jeanne Bucher Jaeger presents Garden of love, an exhibition inspired by Guillaume Logé's book of the same title, and curated by its author. For more than a century, the gallery's identity has naturally resonated with this theme, as reflected in its longstanding commitment to artists whose creative practice is guided by universal, social, environmental, and humanistic values. These are artists who work with the forces of nature, weaving together humanity, history, memory, the cycle of the seasons, the immemorial, and the present day. Spanning from ancient arts to contemporary creation, the exhibition brings together works from different periods in a dialogue centered on nature and love. What if love were to reinvent itself by opening up to nature? The decline of the traditional couple, the blurring of gender lines, and the omnipresence of digital technology: romantic relationships are undergoing a period of profound change.
